**Which document** (path + section/anchor):

**What is wrong**

- [ ] Incorrect (states something false)
- [ ] Missing (feature/command/limit is not documented)
- [ ] Outdated (references a removed command, path or version)
- [ ] Unclear (correct but hard to follow)

**Why it matters**

<!-- e.g. "A new contributor cannot get the tests to run using the documented
     command", "This statement claims a live deployment that does not exist". -->
